description: Create a new standalone package that provides a utility function to detect whether code is running in a browser extension's background context. This package should be extracted from the main codebase to enable independent testing and usage by other packages in the ecosystem.
functional_requirements: Implement a reliable function that returns true when executing in extension background scripts and false otherwise
Support all major browser platforms (Chromium, Firefox, Safari) and manifest versions (MV2, MV3)
Include comprehensive unit tests covering all browser/manifest combinations
Provide proper TypeScript definitions and documentation for external consumption
